package.name: um960_gps_driver
package.description: Serial driver for the Unicore UM960 GNSS/RTK receiver on the Airseekers Tron mower (/dev/serial_rtk -> ttyS4, UART4 @ 0xfeb70000). Parses NMEA (GGA/RMC/GSA/GSV/VTG/GST/GPHPR) and the Unicore proprietary ASCII logs ($GNVER/$GNSTA/$GNCON/$GNREF/$GNRTK, BESTNAVA) plus the Unicore binary synch 0xAA 0x44 0xB5 framing (BESTNAV, msg id 0x0A), and publishes sensor_msgs/NavSatFix /fix, geometry_msgs/TwistStamped /vel, std_msgs/Float32 /heading and std_msgs/String /fix_status. Optional host NTRIP client (v1/v2) injects RTCM into the receiver port and reports correction health on /gps/corrections. In MowgliNext it runs inside the Airseekers backend sidecar (sensors/airseekers) and also publishes the public /gps/status (mowgli_interfaces/GnssStatus). No third-party Python dependencies: the serial port is opened directly with termios.
